subject: Business continuity evidence & RTO/RPO snapshot for Atlas Financial

Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: BCP/DR evidence + RTO/RPO snapshot

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is running a parallel SOC2/BCP review and they've asked for a short packet we can include with our security submission: specifically a recent RTO/RPO snapshot for the primary hosted runtime, the current disaster recovery/playbook, and a brief statement on recent DR test results (last 12 months).

Can you share the documents or point me to a downloadable snapshot by EOD Friday (US Eastern)? Our timeline: internal security review by 5/14, procurement decision 5/21.

Also, if you have a single-line attestation we can include in DocuSign that would be helpful.

Appreciate it — Gina

--
Gina Lopez
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
Atlas Financial

- Marissa will attach runbook excerpts and a one-line attestation you can use in DocuSign.

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.com <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com, g.lopez@atlasfin.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: BCP/DR evidence + RTO/RPO snapshot

Gina / team — attaching the requested artifacts. See inline summary and a short FAQ below. Attachments: rto_snapshot_20260505.pdf (generated from monitoring snapshot), dr_playbook_v3.docx (redacted operational playbook excerpt), bcp_contact_matrix.csv (escalation roles & phone matrix).

Summary (short):
- Scope: Hosted API (primary region: us-west-2) — this packet covers the hosted runtime; Dedicated/Private deployments use the customer's infrastructure and are handled per contract.
- RTO (objective): 15 minutes for control-plane failover (automated) for the serving runtime; 30 minutes for full session failover under sustained load (manual mitigation + automated steps).
- RPO (objective): 0-60 seconds depending on traffic class; we maintain persistent KV caching checkpoints and async replication for session metadata — most customer session state is reconstructed from request prefixes and does not exceed 60s window.
- Recent DR tests: full orchestrated failover test performed 2025-11-12 (planned maintenance test) — results: automated control-plane failover achieved in 12m 40s; session rehydration within RPO targets; post-test runbook actions completed within SLAs.

Key notes and redactions: 
- The attached playbook has redacted internal pager rotations and specific on-call mobile numbers; full contacts are provided under NDA if needed.
- For Dedicated/private customers, topology and recovery time are customer-specific; we can provide a tailored snapshot if Atlas wants Dedicated coverage.

DocuSign attestation (one-line) — suggested text you can paste into a DocuSign field: 
"Redwood Inference attests that the attached RTO/RPO snapshots and disaster recovery playbook reflect the current production BCP/DR posture for the Redwood hosted inference runtime as of the dates shown."

If you want the attestation signed by our security leader (Neha Kapoor or our Head of Security), we can route a signature via DocuSign.

Attachments referenced: rto_snapshot_20260505.pdf (contains timestamped monitoring metrics from 2026-05-05 02:00 UTC), dr_playbook_v3.docx (playbook excerpt with runbook steps), bcp_contact_matrix.csv (role -> escalation contact).

Let me know if you need additional logs or a certified SOC2 extract — SOC2 reports are handled by our compliance team and we can provide the standard SOC2 Type II report under NDA.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Gina Lopez <g.lopez@atlasfin.com>

Neha / Karthik — this is perfect, thank you. The RTO/RPO numbers and the test summary are exactly what our auditors wanted. Two quick clarifications: 

1) The attestation: can you have someone from Security sign the one-line attestation via DocuSign? Our procurement needs a signed attestation. I see your DocuSign link in the related links; if you can send a signed envelope to g.lopez@atlasfin.com we can complete the security packet.

2) Scope confirmation: the hosted runtime details are fine — Atlas does not need Dedicated coverage for this engagement.

If you can get the DocuSign by EOD 5/7 that keeps us on track. Appreciate the fast turnaround.
